import { LitElement, html, svg } from "lit";

// tabler:brand-github - generated by DesignHub. Set size and color, or size with font-size and inherit the text color.
export class BrandGithubIcon extends LitElement {
  static properties = {
    size: { type: String },
    color: { type: String },
  };

  declare size: string;
  declare color: string;

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.size = "1em";
    this.color = "currentColor";
  }

  render() {
    return html`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width=${this.size} height=${this.size} viewBox="0 0 1000 1000" aria-hidden="true" style="color: ${this.color}">${svg`<g transform="translate(0 0) scale(41.667)"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 12h16M12 4v16"/></g>`}</svg>`;
  }
}

customElements.define("brand-github-icon", BrandGithubIcon);

declare global {
  interface HTMLElementTagNameMap {
    "brand-github-icon": BrandGithubIcon;
  }
}
